confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or inspected booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence. Hotel and hostel anchors are lower confidence because prices vary widely by neighborhood, and the estimates assume July high-season rates with Los Angeles taxes and fees included. Cocktail and wine were checked against the beer anchor, as a relative price cross-check. FX caveat: the 2026-10-16 value was taken from a third-party site's report of the RBA table. I did not read the rba.gov.au table directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Los Angeles price levels for a large US coastal tourism metro in July, with cocktail and wine priced relative to the beer anchor.
